_readme: Procedural memory: one Playbook node per task kind (query P6). Agents attach the playbook to every task (L3, L15); the UI shows the steps on each task card.

steps: Read the proof: the class change, the release, the derivation path and the consent conditions it passed
Check the channel (direct contact or family letter) against the person's current preferences
Edit the draft if needed; it must not give medical advice or name the source relative
Approve as the named counsellor, or reject with a reason
Read why the engine refused to decide (gene inheritance, deceased source, conflicting class)
Decide the route with the medical team; record it as a precedent note
Close the task; nothing is sent from this task
Read every failed condition
Confirm no other permitted route exists (the engine checked every derivation)
Acknowledge; nothing is sent
Read the dead ends behind the orphan (who left, which clinic closed)
Assign an owning clinician
Re-run the duty map for this change
Read the decision, the class it rested on and the new class
Review with the owning clinician
Approve a replacing decision (it supersedes the old one) or keep the old one with a reason
The classification moved within the same tier; issue an amended report to the owner
No patient notice is drafted
This lab's classification differs from the current expert-panel review
Route to the lab's curation team for reconsideration
The item closes automatically when a later ClinVar archive shows the submission updated, or when the team records that it reviewed and kept its classification
An approved notice is ready for delivery by you as the owning clinician
Deliver it through your organisation's usual channel (outside this system)
Mark the task done; Recontact never sends anything itself
A cross-organisation handoff failed 5 times
Check that the health-system graph is reachable (/api/health)
Re-run the duty map; the handoff is recreated
